extracted.intended_audience: actors, theatre critics, and informed theatre-going public
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria for assessing nineteenth-century tragic stage performance (as exemplified by Edwin Forrest): naturalism of inner life, timing, physical embodiment, voice, emotional arc, and effects on audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Believable inner life and spontaneous revelation
rubrics_metrics.description: The facts of the situation seemed presenting themselves to his inner gaze in so many pictures; the bewildered astonishment revealed the workings of his brain so clearly that the spectators could scarcely believe that the actor was acquainted with the plot in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: the actor must convey an internally motivated psychological process so convincingly that it appears spontaneous (not simply performed). Example: Forrest delays lines and shows successive inner images (calamity, disappointment, horror) before exploding into wrath. Anti-pattern: immediate, externally obvious reaction that reads as 'acting' rather than inner experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing and judicious withholding of reaction
rubrics_metrics.description: He has lingered to the latest allowable moment... an ordinary actor would have said 'Almighty heavens' at once; but Forrest... did not speak the words till he had for some time prepared the way for them by a display of bewildered astonishment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: withhold the obvious reaction long enough to allow buildup of inner life and audience expectation; precise timing can multiply emotional impact. Scoring note: good timing is the difference between a routine and a moving moment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gradual and credible transitions between mental states
rubrics_metrics.description: The expressions--wonder, rage, horror, despair, frenzy--visibly came out first in slow succession, then in chaotic mixture... the gathered tornado explodes in one burst of headlong wrath.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: transitions should be carried out in invisible, exquisite steps so the change from one state to another feels inevitable. Example: Brutus' gradual shedding of feigned madness into patriotic fury.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical embodiment and dynamic corporeal intensity
rubrics_metrics.description: Every rigid muscle swollen, his convulsed face livid, his dilated eyes emitting sparks, with the crouch and spring of an infuriated tiger he plunges on the hapless Lucullus and hoists him sheer in air.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: use whole-body expression (musculature, posture, movement quality) to embody emotion and create spectacle. Anti-pattern: static or minimal physicality that fails to match the emotional stakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provoking visceral audience response
rubrics_metrics.description: The feelings of the audience, wound to an intolerable pitch, audibly give way in a long, loosened breath, as they sink into their seats with a huge rustle all over the house.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: measure of success is the audience's physical, audible reaction—gasps, silence, weeping, applause. Aim for genuine, collective responses rather than manipulative clichés.

rubrics_metrics.name: Psychological realism and imaginative visualization
rubrics_metrics.description: The facts of the situation seemed presenting themselves to his inner gaze in so many pictures... The opening of the third act in Brutus... he sits, revolving in his breast the now nearly complete scheme for overthrowing the despot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: inhabit the character's imagination so thoughts and plans appear as tangible inner images; stage business and expression should flow from that visualization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thorough preparation and research into real life
rubrics_metrics.description: Forrest kept up the semblance of imbecility, the shambling gait, the dull eyes and vacant face... he had for years studied the traits and phases of these poor beings in visits to lunatic-asylums.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: deep, empirical study of comparable real people enriches portrayals. Example: visiting asylums to observe mannerisms improved the depiction of a feigned madman.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriateness of actor's physical and vocal qualities to the role
rubrics_metrics.description: There was some obvious unfitness of his heavy bearing, noble voice, and native majesty to the shallow and broken qualities of such a character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: consider fit between an actor's inherent traits and the role; where mismatch exists, acknowledge limits or use the mismatch artistically (e.g., a pretended disguise). Anti-pattern: forcing an incompatible persona that breaks credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of contrast and foil to heighten effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The effect of the foregone foil was manifest, and the new and perfect picture stood in luminous relief.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: deliberate contrasts (feigned idiocy vs. revealed nobility) create luminous relief and emphasize the true character. Structural advice: arrange scenes to exploit such contrasts for maximal impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice quality, articulation, and projection
rubrics_metrics.description: With a quick articulation and an expostulating tone he said... the earliest sound of his voice, so deep and resonant, coining and propelling its words in air with such easy and percussive precision, seized the attention of the auditory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: deep resonant voice, clear articulation, and rhythmic propulsion of lines command attention. Scoring note: voice is a primary instrument—control of tone and diction is crucial.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict keeping with time and place (contextual authenticity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appearance, thoughts, words, voice, manner, all in strict keeping with the time and place, he speaks...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: unity of design—costume, manner, diction and ethical frame—should fit the historical or dramatic context to sustain believability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tableau and stage composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Seating himself on a fragment of the fallen statue, in contemplative attitude, his great solitary presence, blending with the entire scene, presented a tableau of the most sombre and romantic beauty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: consider visual composition—poses, stage picture, and relation to set pieces—to create memorable images that support the drama's mood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oratoric power and rhetorical delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: The apostrophe to the dagger was marvellously delivered... he 'waved aloft the bloody dagger, and spoke as if he held the souls of men in his own hand and moulded them at pleasure.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: mastery of rhetorical passages—cadence, emphasis, and dramatic gesture—must be convincing and persuasive; delivery should make oratory feel as action, not declamation for its own sake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nuanced small gestures for tenderness and intimacy
rubrics_metrics.description: His hand meanwhile was playing with her tresses... He pats her lovingly on the shoulder while changing her from his left arm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: small, unforced gestures (touches, kisses, hair-play) are vital to convey intimacy and paternal tenderness; these must feel instinctive rather than staged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled restraint and appropriate collapse
rubrics_metrics.description: His face grows pale. He struggles to lift his arm... he absently wraps his head up in his toga... Suddenly his whole form relaxes and sinks heavily on the stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: know when to restrain expression and when to release; physical collapse must follow organically from the prior control so the end feels earned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conveying moral conflict and complex motivation
rubrics_metrics.description: The second action has the superior human significance... Brutus torn between his parental affection and his public duty... he hesitates, rallies, straightens himself up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: performance must make visible the inner struggle of duty vs. affection; small beats of hesitation, bodily tension, and voice can chart moral decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional pacing across long speeches and soliloquies
rubrics_metrics.description: When left alone, he soliloquizes, beginning with sorrow, and passing in the succeeding parts from sadness to repulsion, then to anxiety, afterwards to hope, and ending with an air of proud joy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: plot the emotional arc within lengthy speeches deliberately; avoid monotony by modulating tempo, dynamics, and physicality to mark shifts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic intensity in violent or furious outbursts
rubrics_metrics.description: He shrieked this fearful curse upon the shrinking criminal with a frenzied energy which so amazed and stirred the audience that sometimes they gave vent to their excitement in a simultaneous shout of applause.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: explosive moments must be rooted in credible buildup; intensity should astonish rather than feel routine or staged for applause.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of elements (voice, gesture, appearance) into a coherent whole
rubrics_metrics.description: Appearance, thoughts, words, voice, manner, all in strict keeping with the time and place... his great solitary presence, blending with the entire scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: assess how well all performance elements integrate to present a consistent, convincing persona; disparity among elements reduces impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employing stage business and props as organic instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: By chance he perceives a knife lying on the stall... At the sight of this providential instrument an electric change passes over his face... He stealthily seizes it... With deep fondness he breathes, 'My dear Virginia,' and gives her quick and fervent kisses, which he appears striving to press into her very soul.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: use props and stage business organically to reveal intent and psychology; the discovery and handling of a prop should feel inevitable and expressive rather than artificial.
